description: Dancers walk round the set one behind another, like a bike chain.

walkthrough.line: Face the way the ring is going and walk {direction} round the set in single file.
walkthrough.teach: Turn to face the way the ring is going — {direction} — and walk round the set one behind another, the way a bike chain goes round, with your hands at your sides. A quarter of the ring is one place along and a half is two. You stop still facing the way you were travelling.
